description: This file defines interfaces and extension methods related to grain storage serialization in Orleans, including the IGrainStorageSerializer interface, extension methods for deserialization, options interface, and a default configurator class for setting up serializers.

classes.name: GrainStorageSerializerExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods for IGrainStorageSerializer, specifically a method to deserialize from ReadOnlyMemory<byte>.

classes.name: DefaultStorageProviderSerializerOptionsConfigurator
classes.description: Provides default configuration for IStorageProviderSerializerOptions, setting the serializer if not already set.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes an object of type T into BinaryData.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes BinaryData into an object of type T.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Extension method to deserialize ReadOnlyMemory<byte> into an object of type T.

methods.name: PostConfigure
methods.description: Configures the serializer options, setting the serializer if it is not already set.
